sentences.text:
Shilpa Mukherjee @ Shilpa Chakraborty vs The State Of West
Bengal & Anr on 10 June, 2025
S/L-03
10-06-2025
Kole / ss Crr 1721 of 2025 Shilpa Mukherjee @ Shilpa Chakraborty

-Vs.-
The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Sabir Ahmed, Mr. S. Sarkar, Mr. D. Banerjee, Mr. E. Ahmed, ... for the petitioner.

The present revisional application has been preferred praying for quashing and/or setting aside of order dated 24.01.2025 passed by the Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Purba Bardhaman in GR Case No. 925 of 2024 arising out of Mongalkot Police Station Case No. 178 of 2024 dated 20.07.2024 under Sections 376/417/504/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 taking cognizance of the offences under Section 379/417/504/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 against the petitioner.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Purba Bardhaman
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Mongalkot Police Station Case No. 178 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: On hearing the learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner and on perusal of the records, it appears that the Mongalkot police Station Case No.178 of 2024 ended in FRT against the petitioner herein namely, Shilpa Mukherjee @ Shilpa Chakraborty, who is the wife of the principal accused Gavinda Chakrabarty @ Govind Chakraborty, who was charge sheeted in the present case for offence punishable under Section 376/417/504/506 of the Indian Penal Code.

It is the contention of the petitioner herein that the trial court vide its order dated 24.01.2025 on considering the final report against the petitioner herein proceeded to exercise its authority under Section 190 (1)(b) of the Cr. P. C. and took cognizance of the offences alleged in respect of the principal accused Gavinda Chakrabarty @ Govind Chakraborty and also the petitioner herein against whom the final report had been filed as there was no evidence substantiating the charges against her.

On hearing the parties and considering the materials on record and the nature of allegations against the petitioner and the FRT submitted, the petitioner herein has made out a prima facie case and as such the revision is required to be heard on merit in presence of the opposite parties.
The petitioner to effect service upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the next date of hearing.

Pending hearing of the revisional application the proceedings in GR Case No. 925 of 2024 arising out of Mongalkot Police Station Case No. 178 of 2024 dated 20.07.2024 under Sections 376/417/504/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code be stayed in respect of the petitioner Shilpa Mukherjee @ Shilpa Chakraborty till 28.07.20225 or until further orders whichever is earlier.
